content.bridge_context: We explore the major shift in human history from being nomads (moving from place to place) to becoming farmers and herders who lived in settled communities.

units.title: Nomadic Life to Settled Life
units.explanation: Early humans moved for food and water. When they learned to plant seeds and tame animals, they started living in one place.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss why early people moved so much. / चर्चा करें कि शुरुआती लोग इतना क्यों घूमते थे।

units.title: The Discovery of Fire
units.explanation: Fire was used for light, cooking meat, and scaring away wild animals. Evidence was found in places like Kurnool caves.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the benefits of fire. / आग के लाभों की पहचान करें।
